subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement stay open now that CONTRIBUTING.md, the labeler workflow, and Barnacle auto-response all reflect the 20-PR cap?
rationale: The implementation side is already covered, but the issue was deliberately pinned and reopened after an earlier closure, so automation should not infer the desired public communication surface.

options.title: Keep It Pinned
options.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the public announcement for the active-PR limit while CONTRIBUTING.md remains the canonical policy text.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Docs
options.body: Close this issue with a short note pointing contributors to CONTRIBUTING.md and Discord for exceptions.

options.title: Replace The Announcement
options.body: Move the announcement to another repository-owned surface, then close this issue once that replacement is live.

recommendation.title: Keep It Pinned
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the public announcement for the active-PR limit while CONTRIBUTING.md remains the canonical policy text.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the recent rename, pin, and reopen actions that most directly express the current issue state.
